description.name: Description
description.value: While bleeding you lose Hit Points at the start of each of your turns. Unless otherwise specified, this Hit Points loss is equal to your half your level (rounded down) or its CR (min of 1) for NPCs.

description.name: Description
description.value: While your are Crippled, you experience the following effects:

• **Reactions Affected**: You cannot take Reactions.
• **Actions Affected**: You can only take an Action or Bonus Action on your turn, not both.
• **No Movement**: Your speed becomes 0 and cannot be increased.

description.name: Description
description.value: While you are Slowed, you experience the following effects:

• **Limited Movement**: You must spend 1 extra foot of movement for every foot you move using your Speed.
• **Reactions Affected**: You cannot take Reactions.
• **Dexterity Saves Affected**: You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
